children: The Saudi-listed Arab National Bank, rated A1 by Moody’s (Stable), A- by S&P (Stable) and A- by Fitch (Stable), has mandated a dollar-denominated benchmark Regulation S perpetual non-call 5.5-year AT1 sukuk.

ANB Capital Company, Arab Bank, ASB Capital, Arqaam Capital, Citi, Goldman Sachs International, HSBC, Mizuho, Standard Chartered Bank and Warba Bank are the mandated joint lead managers and joint bookrunners to arrange a series of fixed income investor calls commencing on September 1, 2026.
The certificates will be issued under the bank’s $3 billion Additional Tier 1 Capital Certificate Issuance Programme established by ANB Tier 1 Sukuk Company Limited with ANB acting as obligor.

This is the latest mandate that marks a gradual return to debt markets by several leading financial institutions in the GCC after a lull following an escalation in tensions in the Middle East last month. Earlier today, Kuwait International Bank also mandated a five-year senior unsecured sukuk.
(Writing by Bindu Rai, editing by Seban Scaria)

title: Saudi-listed Arab National Bank mandates USD AT1 sukuk
